curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain why drivers under eighteen are provisional, who qualifies for the Level One permit, the driver education certificate, the tests, and the parent or guardian signature.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per requirement; the driver education hours appear on their own card.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on what a teen must bring and pass before the permit.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Define the supervising driver, the two Level One time phases, the seat belt and front-seat rules, then the cell phone ban and its emergency exceptions.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast cards on the two time phases and the front-seat rule.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a Level One trip and asking what is allowed.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Separate the nine-month holding period from the driving log hours, define day and night driving, explain who signs the log, and the six-month clean record needed to move up.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each requirement; a contrast card separating months held from hours logged.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on whether a described teen is ready for Level Two.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Show who holds Level Two, the unsupervised hours and the work or volunteer exception, then the passenger limits for under-twenty-one riders and the continuing phone ban.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for hours and each passenger rule; contrast cards on household versus non-household passengers.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a Level Two driver's passengers and hours.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the six-month Level Two hold, the clean-record rule, upgrading online, what the Full Provisional License lifts and the phone rule that stays, and advice for new teen residents.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each step; contrast cards on holding periods and what the full provisional keeps.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on the path from Level Two to a regular license.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain closer DMV monitoring, the any-amount alcohol and drug rule and its revocation, the phone and texting ban, the seat belt rule, and the school discipline rule.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for any amount versus a limit and school discipline versus traffic violations.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on what can cost a provisional licensee the license.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover safety restrictions and the penalty for breaking them, how documents are checked, what a first-time applicant must prove, insurance, and the Not for Federal Identification card.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule and document group; a contrast card on restriction violations.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on restrictions and what documents prove.
